upcoming.title: Tauri v2 Desktop Native App (.exe)
upcoming.description: Ultra-lightweight Windows desktop bundle with low memory footprint, system tray support, and offline local SQLite database synchronization.

upcoming.title: Capacitor Android Package (.apk)
upcoming.description: Mobile native container with hardware acceleration, responsive magnifying touch dock, and remote server IP connector.

upcoming.title: Skecher GPU-Accelerated Magnifying Dock
upcoming.description: macOS-style magnifying navigation dock with RAF throttling, 0% idle CPU usage, and passive touch event listeners.

upcoming.title: Dynamic Remote Server IP Connector
upcoming.description: Configurable backend host resolution stored in local storage to allow mobile APK clients to connect directly to desktop server IP address.

upcoming.title: P2P Local Network Device Sync
upcoming.description: Automatic mDNS discovery between mobile APK and desktop server instances for zero-configuration Wi-Fi sync.

upcoming.title: Encrypted WebDAV and S3 Remote Backup
upcoming.description: Configurable periodic snapshot backups to personal Nextcloud, WebDAV, or AWS S3 compatible buckets with AES-256 encryption.

upcoming.title: SQLite WAL Engine Zero-Latency Memory Caching
upcoming.description: In-memory query result cache with Write-Ahead Logging dirty-page invalidation to achieve sub-millisecond API response times.

upcoming.title: Multi-Factor Habit and Metric Streaks
upcoming.description: Customizable streak rules combining daily commits, journal logs, and calorie/water tracking into unified momentum scores.

upcoming.title: Custom Theme Builder and CSS Token Exporter
upcoming.description: Interactive visual palette designer allowing custom paper tint, ink contrast, and rule borders with one-click JSON export.

releases.title: Initial Release: Local-First Ledger Dashboard

Multi-domain project tracking with GitHub integration and commit graphs
Daily journal editor, food nutrient ledger, game backlog, and media watchlist
Automated daily Discord recap dispatch with customizable webhooks
Field Ledger, Sepia, Kinetic Dark, Cyberpunk, Matcha, and Nordic theme presets

changes.description: Interactive GitHub commit branch visualizer and contribution heatmap
Kanban task board with drag-and-drop sortable lists
Markdown rich text daily journal with word counter and export
Food nutrition tracker with meal categories and daily totals
Game tracker with RAWG metadata search and rating system
Movie and TV watchlist with TMDB API search integration
Fast SQLite queries with indexed foreign keys and JSON aggregation
